submitted.rationale: XRD shows rutile CrSbO4 across the middle of the line (Q≈1.94, 2.49, 3.70). Index 5 also has Cr2O3 (eskolaite) peaks. Index 23 shows minor Sb-oxide peaks. Of the three EQE measurements, the Sb-rich rutile sample at index 19 (Cr0.38Sb0.62) scored highest at 0.0292%. The near-stoichiometric sample at index 14 scored 0.0267%, and the Cr-rich sample at index 9 scored 0.0176%. EQE rises toward the Sb-rich side, so the optimum likely lies near index 19.
